entities.name: NdhM (Q7VE46)
observations: The 115-aa query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q7VE46, NAD(P)H-quinone oxidoreductase subunit M from Prochlorococcus marinus.
Sequence contains the NdhM family domain PF10664 (positions 6–110; i-Evalue 7.5e-36).
NDH-1 is annotated to transfer electrons to quinones and couple redox energy to proton translocation; cyanobacterial NDH-1 also contributes to inorganic carbon concentration.
